name: page_read_models
statements: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `{{prefix}}workflow_csv_nodes`(workflow_id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,node_id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,project_id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,revision BIGINT NOT NULL,position INT NOT NULL,payload LONGTEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(workflow_id,node_id),INDEX csv_project(project_id,workflow_id,position)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `{{prefix}}pressure_dashboard_scopes`(id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin PRIMARY KEY,project_id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,report_id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,position INT NOT NULL,node_hash CHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,step_key VARCHAR(128) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,metadata LONGTEXT NOT NULL,payload LONGTEXT NOT NULL,INDEX scope_selection(project_id,report_id,node_hash,step_key,position),INDEX scope_directory(project_id,report_id,position)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `{{prefix}}plan_graph_cache`(id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin PRIMARY KEY,project_id VARCHAR(101) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,sha256 CHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii NOT NULL,format_version INT NOT NULL,payload LONGTEXT NOT NULL) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

columns.name: summary_data
columns.definition: LONGTEXT GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(data) THEN JSON_REMOVE(data,'$.dashboard.scopes','$.node_logs','$.request_samples') ELSE '{}' END) STORED

columns.name: run_name
columns.definition: VARCHAR(200) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(data) AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(data,'$.run_name'))='STRING' THEN LEFT(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(data,'$.run_name')),200) ELSE '' END) STORED

columns.name: node_hash
columns.definition: CHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin GENERATED ALWAYS AS (SHA2(CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(data) AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(data,'$.node_id'))='STRING' THEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(data,'$.node_id')) ELSE '' END,256)) STORED

columns.name: step_key
columns.definition: VARCHAR(128) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(data) AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(data,'$.step_key'))='STRING' THEN LEFT(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(data,'$.step_key')),128) ELSE '' END) STORED

columns.name: node_hash
columns.definition: CHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin GENERATED ALWAYS AS (SHA2(CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(data) AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(data,'$.node_id'))='STRING' THEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(data,'$.node_id')) ELSE '' END,256)) STORED

columns.name: step_key
columns.definition: VARCHAR(128) COLLATE utf8mb4_bin GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(data) AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(data,'$.step_key'))='STRING' THEN LEFT(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(data,'$.step_key')),128) ELSE '' END) STORED

columns.name: search_text
columns.definition: LONGTEXT GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(data) THEN CONCAT(id,' ',IF(JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(data,'$.name'))='STRING',JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(data,'$.name')),''),' ',IF(JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(data,'$.notes'))='STRING',JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(data,'$.notes')),'')) ELSE id END) STORED

columns.name: monitoring_summary_data
columns.definition: LONGTEXT GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(data) THEN JSON_EXTRACT(data,'$.monitoring_summary') ELSE NULL END) STORED

columns.name: summary_data
columns.definition: LONGTEXT GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(data) THEN JSON_OBJECT('id',id,'project_id',project_id,'status',status,'name',JSON_EXTRACT(data,'$.name'),'created_at',created_at,'workers',JSON_EXTRACT(data,'$.workers'),'controller_id',JSON_EXTRACT(data,'$.controller_id'),'execution_mode',JSON_EXTRACT(data,'$.execution_mode'),'raw_archive',JSON_EXTRACT(data,'$.raw_archive'),'cluster_snapshot',JSON_OBJECT('name',JSON_EXTRACT(data,'$.cluster_snapshot.name'),'controller_id',JSON_EXTRACT(data,'$.cluster_snapshot.controller_id')),'environment_snapshot',CASE WHEN JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(data,'$.environment_snapshot'))='OBJECT' THEN JSON_OBJECT('name',JSON_EXTRACT(data,'$.environment_snapshot.name'),'revision',JSON_EXTRACT(data,'$.environment_snapshot.revision'),'base_host',JSON_EXTRACT(data,'$.environment_snapshot.base_host')) ELSE NULL END) ELSE '{}' END) STORED
